preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver a single-owner firearm feedback chain, consolidate the briefing and event HUD, and advance the complete authored A/B/C objective capability through staged defusal and a readable bomb-detonation finale while preserving clean boot, retained weapon/viewmodel assets, the accepted map/environment tuple, and atomic mission/result authority.

diagnosis.root_cause: Three independent boundaries block the increment. The weapon adapter still derives a transient by prefix-slicing retained PCM while report, impact, VFX, and cleanup ownership remain distributed. Briefing and gameplay events lack one visible presentation authority, producing prohibited decoration and competing notices. The mission objective surface still relies on primitive A/B markers and a glow-core C device with mostly textual state changes, so the A/B capture-device, credible rocket-bomb, visible 0/3-to-3/3 defusal, contextual prompt, and readable terminal-finale capabilities are not integrated as one authoritative A-to-B-to-C presentation chain.

stop_conditions: Do not modify the retained fps_ak74_viewmodel addon, source recordings, coupled weapon/hands hierarchy, transforms, active profile, Hip/ADS offsets, or recoil timings.
Do not claim firearm completion without mixed-output evidence of one recognizable bounded report per authorized quick AUTO or SEMI shot.
Do not claim HUD completion while active route, capture, hit, kill, death, story, or interaction notices overlap, clip, use broad opaque shells, or lose authoritative event identity.
Do not ship primitive rings, flat markers, glow-only cores, or text-only changes as the visible A/B capture devices, C rocket-bomb, or three defusal stages.
Do not claim the bomb finale complete if native layers are unreadable before media entry, detach from the terminal event origin, obscure the world with pure red, or alter health/result authority.
Stop before handoff if clean boot regresses, a candidate callback errors, feedback cleanup leaves live effects, or duplicate cleanup callbacks become nonzero.

strategy.rationale: Use direct production-component binding and explicit observer ownership: replace the PCM adapter rather than retuning duration, consolidate HUD rendering rather than moving duplicate labels, and replace primitive objective presentation with authored state-bound A/B/C instances and a staged terminal wrapper rather than polishing the existing proxies.

code: Run clean_boot and parse/load every changed scene, script, resource, and new asset binding; preserve the retained weapon package, environment tuple, intact authored map, route graph, anchors, and result bindings.

Audit firearm ownership for no prefix slice, one player report owner, separate enemy routing, explicit impact disposition, and lifecycle stops; force timer, tween, capacity-cull, restore, reset, and terminal cleanup with zero residual or duplicate callbacks.

Audit every objective device's actual scene binding, geometry, materials, scale, collision footprint, state adapter, and authoritative event source; unbound imports, hidden proxies, or palette-only duplicates do not count.

Audit prompt ownership so mission feedback observes immutable events and cannot create capture, stage, score, damage, or terminal truth; verify all tester actions are unbound, debug-only, prepare/advance separated, and receipted.
runtime: Begin with a fresh ordinary control smoke covering movement, jump/ground recovery, yaw/pitch, pause/resume, R reload-only, F6 reset, route selector plus movement within 500 ms, and ordinary fire.
Capture mixed output and shot state for ten quick AUTO taps, ten SEMI taps, and held AUTO, repeating after reload/mode switch, F6/checkpoint restore, death/Replay, and fresh deployment.

Traverse the ordinary spawn-to-A-to-B-to-C route without idle setup. At A and B capture outside, approach, center, and edge states for neutral, legal capture, progress, contest/interruption, completion, key commit, and route unlock; verify device, prompt, HUD, audio, and authority agree.

At C exercise 0/3, each stage begin/hold/interruption/completion, leaving the volume, taking damage, combat death/checkpoint restore, Replay, defused, and detonated states. Confirm completed stages latch and partial progress resets correctly. Use fixtures only for branch-local recapture after the ordinary route smoke.
visual: Compare the repaired HUD with the bound reference for hierarchy: objective navigation, contextual interaction, story/radio, temporary feed, persistent totals, countdown, compass, reticle, and weapon remain distinct and non-overlapping.

Inspect A/B device geometry, materials, scale, ground contact, collision, state lights, and silhouette from outside/approach plus center and edge of each volume; fail near-plane crossings, reticle occlusion, full-height translucent curtains, or visible proxy rings.

Inspect the C device from approach and interaction views at 0/3, 1/3, 2/3, 3/3, safe, and detonated states. Each stage must visibly alter the real assembly and remain readable beside compact legal-action prompts.

Prepare then separately advance terminal failure and capture adjacent flash, expansion, debris/pressure-wave, dust/camera-down, red-edge decay, and video-entry frames with matching state and logs; repeat with reduced motion and screen shake disabled. Host/Tester reruns all four phase validations and clean_boot; formal closure remains Tester-owned.

done_when: No product code creates the player report by slicing retained PCM from frame zero; the transient is a dedicated licensed single-shot resource or documented auditioned derivative with zero-crossing boundaries and short fades.
FireAudio and AutoFireAudio remain the sole player-report path; generic shot feedback never replays the retained player source, and enemy spatial reports use a separate bounded cue.

Quick AUTO and SEMI each commit one shot, deduct one round, and request one recognizable transient; held AUTO starts sustained feedback only after a second cadence-valid shot and stops on release and every lifecycle boundary.

Native report, adapter report, miss, concrete, metal, character-hit, and enemy-report stems are separable. Ringing or misleading world-impact cues are disabled when reliable material identity or a compact suitable cue is unavailable, while impact VFX and character-hit feedback remain.
Muzzle flash, tracer, impact, reticle response, report, damage, ammo, and HUD observe the same immutable shot ID within two rendered frames.
Timer, tween, capacity-cull, restore, F6, death, Replay, Home, and deployment cleanup retire each effect identity once; active_effect_count and duplicate_cleanup_callback_count finish at zero.
tasks.instructions: Repair the user-blocking firearm surface first. Replace the arbitrary PCM-prefix construction without editing retained component media. Audition and bind a proper bounded firearm transient through the product adapter. Trace native component report, adapter report, enemy report, miss, concrete, metal, and character-hit stems separately. Keep FireAudio/AutoFireAudio as sole player-report owner; FPSShotFeedback3D may render synchronized muzzle, tracer, impact, and enemy feedback but cannot replay the player recording. Suppress unsuitable player world-impact audio while retaining compact impact VFX and character-hit feedback. Preserve accepted shot scheduling and use token-scoped cancellable cleanup rather than another timeout. Expose shot-correlated owner, playback class, impact disposition, VFX lifetime, and cleanup receipts; host mixed-output recapture remains validation.

done_when: The briefing header contains no slash-style decoration and retains the accepted Barlow Condensed hierarchy, outlined text, moving-background readability, and keyboard/gamepad focus.

Route guidance, capture notices, hit confirmations, elimination rows, death threats, and objective changes each have one declared visible owner; observers may retain receipts but cannot draw duplicate notices.
The top-right feed contains at most five compact borderless rows with icon, action, and subject; eliminations use restrained yellow and player death uses red threat treatment.

Temporary feed rows remain separate from persistent combat totals and objective navigation; large capture/progress detail hides outside proximity, active capture/contest, or a brief ownership transition.
Feed, route, narrative, countdown, compass, reticle, objective band, vitals, totals, and weapon state remain within the 5% safe area without clipping or overlap at 1280x720 at 100% and 200% scale.

Every visible event remains bound to an immutable authoritative ID and bounded lifetime; no broad opaque block, debug label, component name, instructional legend, or permanent duplicated objective detail ships.
Accepted title, pause, settings, truthful paused HUD snapshot, persisted ui_scale=1.0 restoration, result statistics, Replay, and Home behavior remain unchanged.

done_when: Point A and Point B each ship an authored tactical capture device, console, or beacon with distinct silhouettes or mechanisms, grounded PBR materials, clear collision footprints, and neutral/progress/contested/completed state signaling; primitive surface rings remain hidden diagnostics.

Point C ships a credible-scale rocket or missile bomb assembly with clear authored parts, materials, collision, and armed/accessible/defused/detonated visual states; no sphere, cylinder, enlarged primitive, or glow-only core is visible as the device.

The interaction HUD exposes authoritative 0/3, 1/3, 2/3, and 3/3 progress, only the legal current stage, stage name/icon, hold progress, ETA or bounded progress value, threat/interruption reason, and safe/detonated terminal state without covering combat.

Diagnosis, power isolation, and detonator removal each visibly change a real device part, indicator, material, or animation and use distinct interaction/completion feedback. Interrupted partial progress clears while completed stages remain latched; checkpoint, Replay, and new mission restore the correct authoritative stage count.

Concise story/radio, route, danger, objective-change, capture, and interaction prompts observe authoritative events, appear only at the relevant decision point, use bounded lifetimes, and share the shell task's non-overlapping presentation lanes without stacked paragraphs or permanent labels.

One bomb_detonated event sets health to zero and locks combat exactly once. Adjacent frames clearly show flash, fireball, sparks, debris, pressure wave, dust, local light, camera fall, and red-edge decay before death media starts at or after 1.5 seconds.

The finale remains readable at the authoritative origin or an explicitly receipted rebound, never becomes pure red, and transitions through video completion/skip/fallback to the preserved failure result exactly once.

Visible-family requirements are met: ab_capture_devices uses two meaningful production sources/runtime variants across two uses with maximum_single_variant_share=0.5; c_rocket_bomb_device is one justified production singleton; bomb_terminal_effect_stack is one justified authored terminal singleton.
tasks.instructions: Advance the complete mission-facing objective capability, not explosion-only polish. Bind authored A/B capture devices around the existing authoritative anchors without altering the intact map or route graph. Replace the visible C BombCore proxy with one intact credible rocket/missile bomb assembly selected by Developer after candidate preview. Bind its real parts, indicators, materials, or animations to the authoritative three-stage defusal state and expose compact 0/3-through-3/3 interaction presentation. Route state-bound story/radio, danger, route, capture, objective-change, and interaction cues through the shell task's single presentation authority with short decision-focused copy and bounded lifetimes. Preserve MissionController as sole capture, key, countdown, stage, health, and terminal authority. Recompose the native terminal effect wrapper so detonation layers read before death media. Keep or add unbound non-release prepare and separate advance actions for A/B states, each defusal stage, and terminal failure, with branch ID, generation, requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts and release guard; fixtures never satisfy ordinary route acceptance.
